description: The SMART Infrastructure Facility at the University of Wollongong publishes room-level sensor time series distributed through LoRaWAN. Zenodo provides a compressed CSV, a data dictionary and building-plan images free under CC BY 4.0. Droplet sensors sample each minute and report temperature, humidity, light, pressure, movement and battery voltage, alongside node and room identifiers and radio-link quality. These measurements can calibrate building-environment and sensing-network simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the SMART building release. Coverage is this facility; the July 2020 version date does not establish the actual observation interval. The provider explicitly warns that carbon-dioxide and orientation readings are inaccurate, so those channels should not be used as calibrated measurements. Packet loss and unit conversions also require checking. The uncompressed CSV is reported as forty gigabytes. No data archive was downloaded or building model fitted.
